# WEARPACT - ORGANIC COTTON CLOTHING

Contact details: customerservice@wearpact.com, 800-662-7228

## Certifications

- GOTS: Global Organic Textile Standard  
- Fair Trade Certified: Worker well-being and social responsibility  

## Sustainability

- [Sustainability, Certified](https://wearpact.com/sustainability): We don't just claim sustainability, we certify it. We proudly partner with Fair Trade USA, the Global Organic Textile Standard, and SimpliZero to ensure our products are clean, responsible, and organic.
